note: Rewritten from Chhotani (1997), entry 279 (p. 592); the alate, soldier and worker castes are all covered; the synonymy list, literature citations and figure numbers are omitted, and the distribution is not included in the entry.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule straw yellow to yellowish brown; antennae, pronotum and body nearly white; mandibles brown, paler at the base. Head sparsely hairy, body with moderately dense pilosity. Body length 3.75–4.50. Head capsule subcircular, length almost equal to width (length to mandible base 0.80–1.03, maximum width 0.79–1.00). Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 the shortest. Labrum subtriangular, ligulate, apex pointed (length 0.23–0.29, maximum width 0.23–0.28). Mandibles slender, falcate, strongly incurved from the middle onwards, slightly longer than half the head length (length 0.55–0.65). Left mandible with a small tooth above the middle, sometimes absent; right mandible with a similar small tooth slightly below the level of the left tooth. Postmentum strongly arched, subhexagonal (length 0.47–0.60, maximum width 0.41–0.52). Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.37–0.49, maximum width 0.55–0.76), anterior margin with a weak median notch, posterior margin nearly straight or slightly incurved.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Dimorphic. Major worker: head capsule, postclypeus and labrum yellow; antennae, thorax and body pale yellow; pilosity of head and body moderately dense. Body length 4.0–5.0. Head capsule subquadrate (length to mandible base 1.13–1.23, maximum width 1.17–1.27). Antennae 15-segmented, segments 3–5 short and wide, segment 3 the shortest. Postclypeus swollen, hairy, about 1/2 as long as wide. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, anterior lobe upturned and with a conspicuous median notch; mesonotum narrower than pronotum, metanotum wider, the posterior margins of both nearly straight. Minor worker: smaller, antennae 14-segmented, anterior margin of pronotum with a deeper notch. Body length 3.0–3.6, head length 0.93–1.0, head width 0.85–0.98, pronotum length 0.25, width 0.50–0.52.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head pale brown to brown, slightly paler anteriorly; postclypeus pale yellow; antennae yellowish brown; pronotum distinctly paler than the head, with a yellow T-shaped mark and shoulder spots; head and body densely covered with long and short hairs. Body length with wings 18.5, without wings 9.0–10.0. Head capsule subcircular (length to mandible base 1.26–1.31, width including eyes 1.53–1.78). Fontanelle minute, only faintly visible. Eyes large and prominent, maximum diameter 0.51–0.59, minimum diameter 0.45–0.51. Ocelli broadly oval, long diameter 0.25–0.28, short diameter 0.19–0.21, 0.06–0.07 from the eye. Antennae 17–18-segmented. Postclypeus swollen, slightly longer than half its width. Pronotum subsemicircular, length 0.90–1.03, width 1.44–1.68; anterior margin slightly raised medially and with a weak notch, posterior margin convex, feebly concave or nearly straight medially.
